applies_to: Carrier AquaSnap 30RB060-390 air-cooled chillers and 30RB080-390 with Greenspeed Intelligence (ComfortLink controls) fitted with the BACnet communication option.
summary: On the 30RB, BACnet MS/TP comes from a UPC Open controller added to the ComfortLink chiller. It publishes about 300 AV and BV objects (names ending in _1) covering start/stop, emergency stop, control point, demand limit, heat/cool select, setpoints, temperatures, pressures, compressor and fan status for up to three circuits, run hours and alarm state.
default_device_instance: Network number 16101 followed by the MAC address (MAC 20 gives 1610120)
notes: BACnet comes from the optional UPC Open controller, mounted in a separate enclosure below the main control box; object names end in _1.
The Network Points List gives a point description, CCN name, read/write, units, default and range for each object; descriptions here are the printed point descriptions.
AV 137 Run Status codes: 0 Off, 1 Running, 2 Stopping, 3 Delay, 4 Tripout, 5 Ready, 6 Override, 7 Defrost, 8 Run Test, 9 Test. AV 2 Alarm State: 0 Normal, 1 Partial, 2 Shutdown.

The printed table gives Cooling Setpoint 2 (AV 103) the unit "min" and the Cooling Ice Setpoint (AV 99) a delta unit; both are absolute setpoints and are shown here in °F. Some other printed units and defaults look shifted by a row and are kept as printed.

source.title: AquaSnap 30RB060-390 Air-Cooled Chillers and 30RB080-390 with Greenspeed Intelligence - Controls, Start-Up, Operation, Service, and Troubleshooting (Appendix F, BACnet Communication Option, Network Points List)

integration.summary: Address the UPC Open (rotary switches), set the MS/TP baud and protocol DIP switches, and configure the chiller for CCN control. The BMS then starts and stops the chiller with BV 1500 (CCN Chiller Start/Stop) and can write control point, demand limit and heat/cool select; read run status, leaving water temperature, capacity and alarm state.
integration.enable: Set the Operating Control Type to 2 (CCN Control). An external CCN device then forces CHIL_S_S (BV 1500) between start and stop. The Status Unit Control Type reads 2 (CCN) when the Enable/Off/Remote Contact switch is On and 0 (Local Off) when it is Off.
gotchas: The Enable/Off/Remote Contact switch must be On for network start/stop to take effect.
Many objects only apply with options such as heat reclaim, free cooling or a third circuit.
setup: The BACnet option adds a UPC Open controller; it speaks BACnet MS/TP at 9600, 19.2k, 38.4k or 76.8k (Carrier default 76.8k), set on BAS port DIP switches DS1-DS2.
For MS/TP set DS3 to enable, DS4 to E1-485 and the protocol switches DS5-DS8 to MSTP; the EIA-485 jumpers must be set to EIA-485 and 2W.
MAC address from the two rotary switches (tens and ones); the controller reads switches and DIP settings only at power-up.
Device instance is auto-generated as the network number (default 16101) followed by the MAC address, e.g. MAC 20 gives 1610120; change it with i-Vu Tools or a BACview.
Fit a BT485 terminator on the first and last controller of the MS/TP segment.
